Hello LAVAAN members

Growth Modeling with SEM led by Kevin Grimm (Department of Psychology, Arizona State University) is now available as an on-demand streaming seminar. This on-demand seminar on Growth Modeling with SEM offers comprehensive training for analyzing individual change over time. Participants will gain practical skills in applying linear and nonlinear growth models using R, specifically leveraging the `lavaan` package for structural equation modeling. These techniques can be directly applied to researchers' own longitudinal data, enabling more robust and insightful analyses of developmental trajectories and dynamic processes.

Access this seminar at your own pace and please share this with colleagues and students who might benefit!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
